items.claim: Navajo Sterling has the speed advantage at range over Jan Błachowicz.
items.quote: Navajo Sterling's much faster than Jan Błachowicz.

items.claim: Jan Błachowicz lacks good head movement and relies on a high block.
items.quote: Jan Błachowicz never had really good head movement. He's a good blocker.

items.claim: Jan Błachowicz has utilized wrestling and positional control to win rounds in past fights like against Israel Adesanya.
items.quote: Look at the performance against Israel Adesanya. He was just like, 'Okay, hold this dude down.'

items.claim: Aljamain Sterling will use his jab and kicks at range to shut out Jan Błachowicz.
items.quote: I think Aljamain Sterling's going to be able to use that jab, use those kicks at range, really pitch a shutout here
